notes.title: Fall in Myrihyn
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after the full release, we have received tons of suggestions and feedback. We are ready to update the game in the future! Hope we can offer a better experience for all the players. 

And also, Sea Horizon is 25% off in Autumn Sale, don't miss it.

The following are the updates for this time.

Auto-save
The game will be saved with every step on the map. No need to worry about progress loss anymore.

Food system
The game will not end when your food reaches 0! Instead, you will lose HP with every step without food. Giving the player more chances to fight back.

New dungeon: Unknow Territory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/d38521792474cc6d9df43867973943e4c1882c1c.jpg
The classic characters from "TUN TOWN" and "Xuan-Yuan Sword" are here in Myrihyn.
Come and get the special skin after you defeat them!

Bug fix
Found some bugs, and fixed them.

Please wait for a while, hope you all have a great voyage in Myrihyn.

notes.title: Skill upgrade! Obtain more powerful skills in Sea Horizon!

Please wait for a while, hope you all have a great voyage in Myrihyn.

notes.title: Sea Horizon set sail today!
notes.content:
Sea Horizon is leaving early access today!
And we are bringing the new updates.

*The former save file will not be compatible with this update. If your save file is from too many patches ago, you may not play the game with new updates. Please start a new game to solve this issue.

New story and adventure
Add three new playable characters and two new chapters. New adventure mode (multiple characters) separated from story mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/6d8c40e00227b6ec037e22044a521076ea7569a9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/9b2645df69b5cdf76d1b94b94f89ecc5ed246157.jpg

Shorten the single-character chapter
A much smaller map for story mode. The players will have a smoother experience in story mode and can play as other characters sooner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/82c3a7bf9de8f58870aabc31a3c52266b027e212.png

Add a new "Test your luck" event
The event result can be much different every time. There are good and bad, and it's all based on your dice and luck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/1afe3a89e45db2bbe1828a0714c3b76c41b7c35b.png

Another chance
When the player is defeated in a fight, they can try again with different skills and equipment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/5a73bd5f332de12d33f574c84f1565503e2f2da0.png

More power with skin
The skins are not only for the look anymore, each skin has a skill. When the players choose a skin, they can have the skill when the game starts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/ee07445b249b92cc7db65000204f7120cd54757c.png

New exploration effect
Players can gain different effects from all kinds of events when they explore the map. These effects can be good or bad, and some can make a big difference in your adventure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/ed8e75aa3ee97ae2afab5fe9ef5e095765c51db4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/d49db162c0e3ce213e2175763b85ea3f5d2f78a4.png

Add Japanese translation

Thanks for your support and feedback. Hopefully, you will like the full-release edition of Sea Horizon!
Hope you all have a great voyage in Myrihyn.

notes.title: Sea Horizon will be leaving early access on Oct. 20th!
notes.content:
After a few months of fixing and patching, 45 Studio happily announced the exciting news: Sea Horizon will be leaving early access on Oct. 20th.

There is a lot of fixing and tweaking. Hopefully, these changes can bring players the best experience.
Except for the early access content, the full release edition will include the following updates:

New story and adventure
Add three new playable characters and two new chapters. New adventure mode (multiple characters) separated from story mode.
*The former save file will not be compatible with this update. If your save file is from too many patches ago, you may not play the game with new updates. Please start a new game to solve this issue.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/8311236e7fc60b5336d10c891a5bba1b1ff99c8d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/66eede3373b80381404f7ffdc142d22c7cd76a68.png

Shorten the single-character chapter
A much smaller map for story mode. The players will have a smoother experience in story mode and can play as other characters sooner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/82c3a7bf9de8f58870aabc31a3c52266b027e212.png

Add a new "Test your luck" event
The event result can be much different every time. There are good and bad, and it's all based on your dice and luck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/1afe3a89e45db2bbe1828a0714c3b76c41b7c35b.png

Another chance
When the player is defeated in a fight, they can try again with different skills and equipment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/5a73bd5f332de12d33f574c84f1565503e2f2da0.png

More power with skin
The skins are not only for the look anymore, each skin has a skill. When the players choose a skin, they can have the skill when the game starts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/ee07445b249b92cc7db65000204f7120cd54757c.png

New exploration effect
Players can gain different effects from all kinds of events when they explore the map. These effects can be good or bad, and some can make a big difference in your adventure.

Add Japanese translation
You can play Sea Horizon with Japanese in the full release edition.

--

Thanks for your support and feedback. Hopefully, you will like the full-release edition of Sea Horizon!

Hope you all have a great voyage in Myrihyn.

notes.title: New challenges for the adventures!
notes.content:
Except for the game balance update, Sea Horizon is participating in the "Night Market Fest" between 8/5 and 8/9. Don't miss it!

The following are the updates for this time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/9cafb3b87b4a9864fc1866f4ab01796394cbe5b7.jpg
Character skills adjustment
We redesigned a lot of skills for every character, making some of the high-cost skills more powerful.

Character equipments adjustment
With the skill balance, we also changed a lot of equipment. Now they provide fewer resources, but with stronger skills, they have more value than before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/dea95113473efd64074421388a023f02f40461e4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/f3ad720b98d385b3abfa6b70b048541b554924e1.jpg
Dynamic enemy level
Now the enemy will become stronger as you explore the world. 
Some of them even obtain different skills and AI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/3406a0e97b86a8a894de17bdf6bae4625372b7bd.jpg
New temple and random event
We put some new temples on the map. With a bit of Anchor, they will grant you some blessing. 
Also, the player can buy random equipment from some events.


Translation and bug
Fixed some issues of translation and minor bugs.


Please wait for a while, hope you all have a great voyage in Myrihyn.

notes.title: Update: Demo
notes.content: We have released two patches after early access. It's time to give the demo a little bit of love.

notes.title: Keep updating the game, lot of QoL changes.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after the early access, we have received tons of suggestions and feedback. We are ready to update the game in the future! Hope we can offer a better experience for all the players. The following are the updates for this time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/2007d4ab9e28bb414be9b415701c60cd86985455.jpg

The enemy encounter
We removed the random encounter on the map. Now the players can see the enemies directly.
Now the players can avoid the weak enemy and plan their route more freely.

Prompt on the map
We added some text for special locations on the map, such as fights, camps, and bonfires.
The players can figure out what those locations do before stepping on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044846/32a60c862c03686eb25b5b6d6194bc94d909d195.jpg

The title screen
We combined the story and dungeon mode into "Adventure." The players can choose between story or dungeon in Adventure.
If the players can't beat the dungeon. They can unlock different characters through story mode and try different combinations.

Achievement
We added the achievement. The players can get the achievement by defeating dungeon bosses.

The controller button prompt
And last but not least, players can play Sea Horizon with a controller now. We added the button prompt for the controller.

And also, we made some changes as the following.

1. Fix the skills level of Priest and Artisan.
2. Fix some of the enemies' levels.
3. Rebalance the enchantment "Overload" and "Lucky Shell" for Explorer. They are stronger and easier to proc.
4. Rebalance the final fight for Priest and Explorer in story mode. They are proper challenges now.

Please wait for a while, hope you all have a great voyage in Myrihyn.

notes.title: Early access available now！
notes.content:
New characters: Explorer, Apothecary, Shaman, Priest, and Artisan. 

Each of them possesses different skills and equipment. Artisan is capable of dealing massive damage and debuffing the enemies at the same time. Priest has abilities to heal and buffing allies. This allows more combinations of gameplay during new dungeon and adventures.

New Chapter：Forsaken Archipelago

A new adventure; a map in which players can pick 3 characters for combat and exploration. Players are able to find more powerful enchanted equipment in caves, and there are 3 new bosses waiting for your challenging. 

New Dungeon：Island Dungeon

A new dungeon: an 8 levels dungeon with a different boss waiting to be conquered. The resources in Island Dungeon are scarcer than in general maps; players have to get well-prepared with their skills and equipment.

Several new enchantments; more enchantments mean more item variety and more builds for players to try out.
